-- task: ads_register_attribution_board_d_d
-- doc: 注册归因看板产品渠道日指标（dt x app_id x attributed_channel；17 可加计数 + 2 审计）
-- 频率: daily（T-1；须在渠道回写 apply 之后）
-- params: 无
-- 幂等: INSERT OVERWRITE 当日分区
-- 取数: 入围=注册+安装 V1.0.11；有候选及以后=结果表；比率/均值不落表
-- 上游: dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2, dwd.dwd_app_install_d, dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d

INSERT OVERWRITE ads.ads_register_attribution_board_d_d PARTITION (p$[yyyyMMdd-1]) (
    dt,
    app_id,
    attributed_channel,
    eligible_register_cnt,
    has_candidate_cnt,
    attribution_success_cnt,
    high_confidence_cnt,
    rewrite_success_cnt,
    rewrite_fail_cnt,
    rewrite_skipped_cnt,
    rewrite_not_writeback_cnt,
    rewrite_unknown_cnt,
    score_lt60_cnt,
    score_60_79_cnt,
    score_80_99_cnt,
    score_gte100_cnt,
    score_sum,
    time_diff_seconds_sum,
    click_success_cnt,
    view_success_cnt,
    etl_batch_id,
    updated_at
)
WITH reg_enroll AS (
    SELECT
        r.dt,
        r.app_id,
        r.uid,
        r.event_id AS register_event_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY r.event_id
            ORDER BY i.event_time DESC
        ) AS install_rn
    FROM dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2 r
    INNER JOIN dwd.dwd_app_install_d i
        ON  r.app_id = i.app_id
        AND r.device_id = i.device_id
        AND i.attribution_flag = 1
    WHERE r.dt = '$[yyyy-MM-dd-1]'
      AND (
            LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.channel, ''))) IN ('organic', 'natural', 'self')
         OR TRIM(COALESCE(r.channel, '')) = ''
      )
      AND r.uid IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(r.device)) = 'ios'
      AND r.attribution_flag = 1
      AND r.device_id IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(r.device_id) <> ''
      AND i.device_id IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(i.device_id) <> ''
      AND i.dt BETWEEN DATE_SUB('$[yyyy-MM-dd-1]', INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND '$[yyyy-MM-dd-1]'
      AND i.event_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(r.event_time, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
                           AND DATE_ADD(r.event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
),
elig AS (
    SELECT dt, app_id, uid, register_event_id
    FROM reg_enroll
    WHERE install_rn = 1
),
res AS (
    SELECT
        f.dt,
        f.app_id,
        f.uid,
        f.register_event_id,
        f.attributed_channel,
        f.attribution_status,
        f.confidence_level,
        f.score,
        f.time_diff_seconds,
        f.source_event_type,
        f.rewrite_status,
        f.rewrite_reason
    FROM dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d f
    WHERE f.dt = '$[yyyy-MM-dd-1]'
      AND f.source_event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(f.source_event_id) <> ''
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        e.dt,
        e.app_id,
        f.attributed_channel,
        CASE WHEN f.register_event_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_candidate,
        CASE WHEN f.attribution_status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_success,
        CASE
            WHEN f.attribution_status = 'success' AND f.confidence_level = 'high' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_high_conf,
        CASE
            WHEN f.attribution_status IS NULL OR f.attribution_status <> 'success' THEN 'not_success'
            WHEN f.rewrite_status = 1 THEN 'rw_success'
            WHEN f.rewrite_status = 0 THEN 'rw_failed'
            WHEN f.rewrite_status IS NULL
             AND f.rewrite_reason IN ('未回写-app未灰度', '已有真实渠道-免归因') THEN 'rw_skipped'
            WHEN f.rewrite_status IS NULL
             AND f.rewrite_reason = '未回写-归因仍organic' THEN 'rw_not_writeback'
            ELSE 'rw_unknown'
        END AS rewrite_class,
        CASE
            WHEN f.attribution_status IS NULL OR f.attribution_status <> 'success' THEN 'not_success'
            WHEN f.score < 60 THEN 'sc_lt60'
            WHEN f.score < 80 THEN 'sc_60_79'
            WHEN f.score < 100 THEN 'sc_80_99'
            WHEN f.score >= 100 THEN 'sc_gte100'
            ELSE 'sc_null'
        END AS score_class,
        CASE
            WHEN f.attribution_status = 'success' AND f.score IS NOT NULL THEN f.score
            ELSE 0
        END AS score_contrib,
        CASE
            WHEN f.attribution_status = 'success' AND f.time_diff_seconds IS NOT NULL THEN f.time_diff_seconds
            ELSE 0
        END AS time_diff_contrib,
        CASE
            WHEN f.attribution_status = 'success'
             AND f.source_event_type = 'landing_page_click' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_click_success,
        CASE
            WHEN f.attribution_status = 'success'
             AND f.source_event_type = 'landing_page_view' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_view_success
    FROM elig e
    LEFT JOIN res f
        ON  e.dt = f.dt
        AND e.app_id = f.app_id
        AND e.uid = f.uid
        AND e.register_event_id = f.register_event_id
)
SELECT
    dt,
    app_id,
    attributed_channel,
    COUNT(*)                                                            AS eligible_register_cnt,
    SUM(is_candidate)                                                   AS has_candidate_cnt,
    SUM(is_success)                                                     AS attribution_success_cnt,
    SUM(is_high_conf)                                                   AS high_confidence_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rewrite_class = 'rw_success'       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rewrite_success_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rewrite_class = 'rw_failed'        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rewrite_fail_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rewrite_class = 'rw_skipped'       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rewrite_skipped_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rewrite_class = 'rw_not_writeback' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rewrite_not_writeback_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rewrite_class = 'rw_unknown'       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rewrite_unknown_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN score_class = 'sc_lt60'            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS score_lt60_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN score_class = 'sc_60_79'           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS score_60_79_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN score_class = 'sc_80_99'           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS score_80_99_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN score_class = 'sc_gte100'          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS score_gte100_cnt,
    SUM(score_contrib)                                                  AS score_sum,
    SUM(time_diff_contrib)                                              AS time_diff_seconds_sum,
    SUM(is_click_success)                                               AS click_success_cnt,
    SUM(is_view_success)                                                AS view_success_cnt,

/*
-- task: ads_register_attribution_board_d_d
-- doc: 注册归因看板产品渠道日指标（dt x app_id x attributed_channel；17 可加计数 + 2 审计）
-- 频率: daily（T-1；须在渠道回写 apply 之后）
-- params: 无
-- 幂等: INSERT OVERWRITE 当日分区
-- 取数: 入围=注册+安装 V1.0.11；有候选及以后=结果表；比率/均值不落表
-- 上游: dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2, dwd.dwd_app_install_d, dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d
-- 表头用块注释包住：Stage 4 面板执行时以 -- 开头的表头会导致整条语句被当成注释（2026-09-10 实测）
*/

INSERT OVERWRITE ads.ads_register_attribution_board_d_d PARTITION (p$[yyyyMMdd-1]) (
    dt,
    app_id,
    attributed_channel,
    eligible_register_cnt,
    has_candidate_cnt,
    attribution_success_cnt,
    high_confidence_cnt,
    rewrite_success_cnt,
    rewrite_fail_cnt,
    rewrite_skipped_cnt,
    rewrite_not_writeback_cnt,
    rewrite_unknown_cnt,
    score_lt60_cnt,
    score_60_79_cnt,
    score_80_99_cnt,
    score_gte100_cnt,
    score_sum,
    time_diff_seconds_sum,
    click_success_cnt,
    view_success_cnt,
    etl_batch_id,
    updated_at
)
WITH reg_enroll AS (
    SELECT
        r.dt,
        r.app_id,
        r.uid,
        r.event_id AS register_event_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY r.event_id
            ORDER BY i.event_time DESC
        ) AS install_rn
    FROM dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2 r
    INNER JOIN dwd.dwd_app_install_d i
        ON  r.app_id = i.app_id
        AND r.device_id = i.device_id
        AND i.attribution_flag = 1
    WHERE r.dt = '$[yyyy-MM-dd-1]'
      AND (
            LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.channel, ''))) IN ('organic', 'natural', 'self')
         OR TRIM(COALESCE(r.channel, '')) = ''
      )
      AND r.uid IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(r.device)) = 'ios'
      AND r.attribution_flag = 1
      AND r.device_id IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(r.device_id) <> ''
      AND i.device_id IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(i.device_id) <> ''
      AND i.dt BETWEEN DATE_SUB('$[yyyy-MM-dd-1]', INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND '$[yyyy-MM-dd-1]'
      AND i.event_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(r.event_time, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
                           AND DATE_ADD(r.event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
),
elig AS (
    SELECT dt, app_id, uid, register_event_id
    FROM reg_enroll
    WHERE install_rn = 1
),
res AS (
    SELECT
        f.dt,
        f.app_id,
        f.uid,
        f.register_event_id,
        f.attributed_channel,
        f.attribution_status,
        f.confidence_level,
        f.score,
        f.time_diff_seconds,
        f.source_event_type,
        f.rewrite_status,
        f.rewrite_reason
    FROM dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d f
    WHERE f.dt = '$[yyyy-MM-dd-1]'
      AND f.source_event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(f.source_event_id) <> ''
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        e.dt,
        e.app_id,
        f.attributed_channel,
        CASE WHEN f.register_event_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_candidate,
        CASE WHEN f.attribution_status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_success,
        CASE
            WHEN f.attribution_status = 'success' AND f.confidence_level = 'high' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_high_conf,
        CASE
            WHEN f.attribution_status IS NULL OR f.attribution_status <> 'success' THEN 'not_success'
            WHEN f.rewrite_status = 1 THEN 'rw_success'
            WHEN f.rewrite_status = 0 THEN 'rw_failed'
            WHEN f.rewrite_status IS NULL
             AND f.rewrite_reason IN ('未回写-app未灰度', '已有真实渠道-免归因') THEN 'rw_skipped'
            WHEN f.rewrite_status IS NULL
             AND f.rewrite_reason = '未回写-归因仍organic' THEN 'rw_not_writeback'
            ELSE 'rw_unknown'
        END AS rewrite_class,
        CASE
            WHEN f.attribution_status IS NULL OR f.attribution_status <> 'success' THEN 'not_success'
            WHEN f.score < 60 THEN 'sc_lt60'
            WHEN f.score < 80 THEN 'sc_60_79'
            WHEN f.score < 100 THEN 'sc_80_99'
            WHEN f.score >= 100 THEN 'sc_gte100'
            ELSE 'sc_null'
        END AS score_class,
        CASE
